text: Computer science and technology is an interdisciplinary field that studies the theory, design, development and application of computer systems, covering core areas such as algorithm theory, software development, hardware design and data processing. It aims to cultivate professional talents with computational thinking, system development capabilities and interdisciplinary application literacy. This major is deeply integrated with cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data and cloud computing, and it is the foundation and core of the information technology field.
